features.name: Automated quality baseline

features.name: Events and attendance

features.name: Training and compliance
features.scope: Review courses, programs, cohorts, sessions, external training, skills testing, credit, recertification, waivers, dashboards, and compliance reporting.

features.scope: Review catalog, lots, stock, assignments, transfers, temporary issues, returns, scanning, labels, fulfillment, departure clearance, payments, and reconciliation.

features.name: Facilities and locations

features.name: Application-wide frontend experience
features.scope: Review navigation, search, forms, loading and error states, destructive safeguards, accessibility, responsiveness, PWA and offline behavior, performance, and discoverability.

features.name: Deployment and operations
features.scope: Review Docker modes, proxy assumptions, migrations, seed idempotency, backups and restore, health checks, task workers, monitoring, upgrade safety, and documentation.

features.name: Finding validation and roadmap
features.scope: Deduplicate findings, verify evidence, assign priority and effort, add acceptance criteria and regression tests, and assemble the phased application-wide roadmap.
